name: Complete Medical Supply Inc
old_description: Our knowledgable sales representatives look forward to helping you!
about:
Complete Medical Supply Inc is based in Suffern, New York, and was founded in 1988. The company operates as a health product manufacturer, importer, and master wholesaler. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company manufactures its own Blue Jay™ brand of healthcare products and offers a catalog of over 14,000 medical, homecare, ergonomic, and healthcare items. Its manufacturing arm, Complete Medical Supplies Manufacturing Group, produces the Blue Jay line. Services include drop shipping with no minimum orders, custom assembly of college student kits for physical therapy, occupational therapy, nursing, and medical programs, a 24/7 online ordering platform called Complete-Connect™, custom flyer creation, and datafeed integration for resellers. Local truck delivery is available in its service area.

Customers include medical-surgical facilities, homecare providers, ergonomic product retailers, and healthcare distributors. The company also serves college and university programs, providing custom PT/OT/nurse/medical student kits. Both professionals (end users) and resellers can open accounts.

Complete Medical Supply emphasizes cost reduction through offshore sourcing solutions, no-minimum-order drop shipping, and digital tools like Complete-Connect™ for round-the-clock ordering and account management. The custom flyer and datafeed programs aim to help resellers market products more effectively.
